governance_rule: Safe coherent implementation WOs MAY be combined, but merge + deploy + activation are NEVER combined in one WO. Each gate is explicit.

wos.purpose: Resolve N-1: append atomicity (framing, partial-tail detection, fsync policy, rotation-race, read-side validation).
Resolve N-2: redaction for non-string values (bytes/int-id/list/mapping/dataclass/enum/nested/raw-obj); fixed closed schema primary.
Add passive shadow-adapter invocation reading an immutable snapshot of watchdog/adapter state (main.py assembly point). Read-only, no consume, RefusingShadowExecutor.
Additive passive observation surface exposing an immutable copy of current-authority outcome without consuming the one-shot recovery request.
Install the governed DISABLED Phase-2 config (DB/mounted), schema-validated. No activation.
Provision project-owned evidence mount (UID/GID/perms/quota/rotation). No secrets/Redis/SQL.
Build reproducible image from pinned canonical SHA + source-SHA/build-UTC labels + SBOM/scans. Stage B.
R2D2 deployment-readiness audit of the built image. Stage C.
Deploy-dark with disabled config; validate health/market-data/authority. Stage D. Deploy ONLY, no activation.
R2D2 post-deploy-dark audit: present-but-inactive, no JSONL, authority unchanged, N-1/N-2 closed. Stage E.
Bounded project-local status/health surface for shadow state (no Redis/SQL unless separate architecture decision).
Separately-authorised config-only shadow_enabled=true. Stage F. Activation ONLY, no image change.
Bounded live observation; collect evidence. Stage G.
R2D2 post-observation audit. Stage H. Terminal; NO Phase-3.
Append-only correction of HELM/blueprint deployment-truth (canonical vs deployed SHA; f69df68->71ea3bd staleness; capability-deploy vs activation). No history rewrite.
Separate CA-authorised repair of the missing dated PR#108 R2D2 audit fabric key. Not a deployment blocker.
Wire PR104 predeploy gate + PR107 transition validator + PR105 CI into the governed pre-build/pre-deploy checklist.
Add a source-SHA + build-UTC OCI label to the image build (version-reporting) so capability-present is distinguishable from capability-active. Dockerfile change is impl-only, no deploy.
